protocolPolicy: Legacy migration support starts at Bridge/Mod V1.3. V1.3 and V1.4 legacy updaters can update directly to Bridge V1.43 through BRIDGE_COMPATIBILITY.json. Protocol 43 remains the unified wire generation used from V1.41 onward; once Bridge V1.43 is installed, run UPDATE_DUALSENSE.exe to download the matching BeamNG mod ZIP and follow the manual installation instructions.

protocols.description: Old protocol generation retained because the supported V1.3 generation still uses protocol 41. Versions older than V1.3 are intentionally outside the supported migration range.
Legacy generation used by later pre-V1.41 releases such as V1.4. V1.2 itself is intentionally outside the supported migration range.
Unified wire generation introduced by V1.41 and reused by V1.43.
